arrival_normalization: subtract the selected cohort minimum arrival time; preserve all relative gaps

response_model.formula: rho = (bilinear(T, clip(3*(cpu_per_gpu/3)/phi_c), clip(62.5*(ram_per_gpu/62.5)/phi_m)) / bilinear(T, clip(3/phi_c), clip(62.5/phi_m))) ** 0.5
response_model.interpolation: bilinear on official Synergy CPU x RAM matrix
response_model.application_mapping: use the frozen application_template_rule from the base config

policy_execution_order: trace order, then early/middle/late, then B1/SY/B4/B5/B3; strictly sequential
synergy_gpu_type_rule: demand <= 6: rtx; demand == 8: dgx-ext; demand >= 10: even numeric job ID aws, odd numeric job ID dgx-ext
template_mapping_rule: use the frozen application_template_rule from the base config
parameter_policy: No workload, capacity, response, mapping, objective, solver parameter, or policy change after the targeted Medium validation begins.
